name: veterinary_clinic_system_006_bordetella_boarding_gate
instruction: Run the boarding bordetella gate for the episode. A dog may not check in for boarding unless its bordetella vaccination stays current through the end of the stay. For every boarding reservation with status in ('reserved','checked_in') whose patient is canine and whose latest bordetella due_date is on or before the reservation's check_out date, OR whose patient has no bordetella record at all, update the reservation's status to 'waitlisted_vax' and add hold_reason='bordetella lapse before checkout', leaving all other reservation fields untouched. For each newly waitlisted reservation, push one outbound communications row to the owner with patient_id set: channel='email', direction='outbound', subject='Boarding hold — <batch_code>', body='Reservation <id> for <PatientName> is on hold; bordetella due <due or 'missing'> is before checkout <check_out>.', logged_by='system', occurred_at=episode. Then write one ops_reports row with report='boarding_gate', batch_code, total_waitlisted (all statuses), canine_reserved_count, canine_checked_in_count, missing_bordetella_count, lapsed_due_count, and episode_date. Finally append one audit_log entry with action='BOARDING_GATE_REVIEW', actor='system', actor_role='system', target_collection='boarding_reservations', target_id=<batch_code>, details summarizing the counts, and occurred_at=episode. Leave every other reservation, every non-canine reservation, and all unrelated collections untouched.
_max_steps_note: measure via live gold run in QC session (anti-brute-force); this session cannot run against a container
_par_steps_note: measure via live gold run in QC session; placeholder only

success_criteria.summary: Expected set = canine boarding reservations (status 'reserved' or 'checked_in') whose latest bordetella due_date <= dp(check_out) or who have no bordetella record. Each target reservation is updated exactly once with status='waitlisted_vax' and hold_reason='bordetella lapse before checkout' while preserving other fields. One outbound email per target reservation is created keyed by (subject, patient_id). One ops_reports row and one audit_log entry are created for the batch, with counts matching a Python filter and an independent SQL query. All other reservations and all non-blast collections remain byte-identical to seed.

checks.collections: all seeded collections outside the declared blast_radius

checks.expect: target reservations updated with exact status/hold_reason and no other field changed; all others byte-identical to seed
target reservation count and per-status breakdown computed by Python and SQL and matched to ops_reports

hazards: The gate applies to both 'reserved' and 'checked_in' reservations; restricting to 'reserved' misses checked-in canine rows such as ids 1 and 3.
Non-canine reservations (feline, avian, exotic, equine) must not be waitlisted, even if they have a bordetella vaccination row in the table.
A canine patient with no bordetella record at all is treated as lapsed and must be waitlisted.
The comparison is against the reservation's check_out date, not the episode date or check_in date; reservation 76 (patient 52, due 2026-11-14, checkout 2026-11-23) is a canonical lapsed case.
Only the target reservations' status and hold_reason change; all other fields (check_in, check_out, run_id, notes, created_at, etc.) must remain byte-identical to seed.
Multi-pet owners may have several reservations on hold; communications must be one per target reservation (keyed by reservation id + patient_id), not one per owner.

uniqueness_report.differentiation_note: Fuses a multi-status boarding gate, missing-record handling, owner notification, and an aggregate audit/report into a single idempotent batch. The date comparison is against checkout rather than the episode date, and the entire outcome is validated by dual-path SQL/Python counts. No public benchmark combines a kennel gate with owner communication and audit logging.
